From what I know of the common one (Cloudflare's `agents/ai-react`, which wraps the Vercel AI SDK's `useChat`): it doesn't throttle by default. Each streamed chunk updates the messages state and triggers a re-render. The underlying `useChat` does take an optional throttle setting (`experimental_throttle` in AI SDK 4.x, `throttle` in newer versions) that batches UI updates to at most once every N ms. Whether `useAgentChat` passes that option through depends on the version, so check your installed `agents` package, or point me at the project and I'll confirm.
